verdict.rationale: Together AI is an inference platform, and an inference API could plausibly accept MCP servers as tool sources, so the axis applies. The pack shows no such MCP-client capability. Function calling is a developer building block that leaves tool execution to the application, and the Docs MCP server is Together serving an MCP server to other agents, which is the server role, not plugging MCP servers into Together.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
